description: Analyze connected life data and identify important things you never thought to ask about.
notes: Shared kit was not present at build time; a minimal local Kit fallback is inlined.

notes.note: 'The most expensive risks are the ones you never thought to ask about' is the best line in the home/life cluster, and pattern-matching your life against thousands of post-mortems is a genuinely novel mechanic. The freemium fear-plus-curiosity scan has real viral potential. Monetization is affiliate-thin, but the top of funnel is the asset.
Scan my digital life surfaces risks; zero errors.

notes.change: New 'Export blindspot report' downloads a shareable checklist with per-risk fix and addressed status.
